notes.title: **Parameter locks**
notes.text: **Parameter locks** (Elektron style; spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-24-parameter-locks-design.md): - ENV: the white keys as the selected track's steps on every page. ENV (unused before) toggles STEPS / TRACKS on its release, its LED lit and a padlock in the top bar (left of the battery, every page) in STEPS; the mode is global, not saved (off at power-on). In STEPS the keys tap / hold steps as on SEQ on HOME, TRACKS (armed too), SOUND, LAYER, FX, LFO and COMP, and play no drum (REC ALL records no hits then); ENV held + OCT+ / OCT- changes the bank; OCT+ held + a step its accent, OCT+ alone and OCT- keep their page's job (SOUND to LAYER on OCT+'s release, LAYER back, the LFO's RATE MODE). ENV turns KEYS off and SCL STEPS off. ENV off (TRACKS) is the keys exactly as before. (Device test 2026-10-25: ENV, and OCT- clearing a held step's locks, sometimes needed a second press: the press time kept the clock's own bit 1, the "used" flag.) - Locks: in STEPS, hold a step and turn any knob MOTION can record, on HOME, TRACKS (LEVEL, PAN), SOUND, LAYER, FX, SLICER, RESON, FILTER, LFO and LFO DEST: that step gets its own value for that knob (LOCK STEP 5 on top, the cells show the step's values, a locked one inverted; the knob itself and its base untouched; a turn right after the press works, the release then toggles nothing; HOME's strip, too narrow for it, says LOCK 5). Knobs MOTION can't record do nothing while a step is held. Step held + OCT- tap: that step's locks on this page's knobs cleared (STEP 5 LOCKS CLEARED); OCT- held 0.6 s: all its locks (STEP 5 ALL CLEARED); OCT- with no step held keeps its job. LOCKS FULL at 1024 events. SEQ STEP keeps PROB / RATCH / ACC on a held step; a song's rows are not edited. - Playback (motion.c): a lock sets its knob for its own step only, on top of what the knob holds there (its value, or motion's held value; an LFO on it modulates round the locked value), and the knob snaps back on the next step. A step that is off keeps its locks dormant. Locks play whatever MOTION's PLAY says; MOTION CLEAR leaves them; CLEAR TRACK, TOOLS CLR* and INIT* remove them. A SONG row plays its own slot's locks and none leaks into the next row; STOP, a model change, a MIDI LEARN CC and a preset SAVE see the knob's own value, never a lock's. A/B renders: build/drum_renders/locks_off.wav, locks_on.wav (DECAY and CUT locked on steps 4 8 12 16). - Shown: in STEPS the footer's step strip underlines each locked step of the bank shown (a song's row: its slot's); SEQ > MOTION's KNOB 2 / 3 show the selected track's MOTION (recorded events, was EVENT) and LOCKS counts. Screens: build/ui_shots/locks/ (sound_held, foot_bank1, motion_counts). - MOTION: 1024 events per project (was 128), shared with the locks, kept in the project's lock bank (its own flash object, saved just before the project record, which links it: a save cut by a power loss keeps the last whole pair). Projects are now "FDRF"; FDRE and every older format load with their motion as before. 0.23.x reads a project saved now as an empty slot (LOAD FAILED at power-on; downgrade safe, not supported). A bank that can't be read (wrong inside, another slot's, not the one the record links) loads empty and the FM-1 says LOCKS LOST; it is never misread. A step's events are found by a binary search in the audio ISR (no scan of every event). - Lock banks: four new flash objects (OBJ_LOCKS0..3, two sectors each at 0xD4000..0xDBFFF, storage.c; user decision 2026-10-24, frozen baseline moved to frozen-base-10 for that object-table change). They take the last 32 KiB of user sample slot 3: **USR3 now holds up to 48 KiB** (USR1 / USR2 80 KiB as before). A longer USR3 is shortened in flash once at power-on, before anything writes the banks (USR3 SHORTENED TO 48K; zones past 48 KiB dropped, one across it cut, its CRC new; a power cut during that one rewrite empties USR3, nothing else). If that rewrite fails (a flash error), nothing writes the lock banks that boot (USR3 CLAMP FAILED; SAVE and RENAME say so and keep the project in RAM), so an older Hortator never plays them as USR3's sound. A RENAME of a project whose bank is only in RAM (an older project converted at power-on, or after a SAVE ERROR) writes the bank before the record.
